 BANA vs AFG-A Match Prediction & Analysis 
 Bangladesh A and Afghanistan A cricket team will lock horns in the 6th match of the ACC Men’s Asia Cup Rising Stars 2026 on Saturday, 21st November. The venue for this match is West End Park International Cricket Stadium, Doha and the scheduled start time is 15:30 IST. 
 Bangladesh A are coming off a dominant victory against Hong Kong in the tournament opener. On the other hand, Afghanistan A suffered a one-sided defeat against Sri Lanka A on the opening day. Both teams would aim for two points in pursuit of top-two finish in the group table. 
 Head to Head History: Bangladesh A and Afghanistan A have played against each other two times in Rising Stars Asia Cup. Both teams emerged victorious in one game each.

 TEAMS PREVIEW 
 Bangladesh A Preview 
 Bangladesh A head into the Rising Stars Asia Cup 2026 contest on the back of a convincing eight-wicket victory over Hong Kong. Chasing a target of 220, Bangladesh reached 220/2 in just 41 overs. Captain Saif Hassan led from the front with an unbeaten 86 off 116 deliveries, while Yasir Ali provided the finishing touch with an explosive 71 not out off just 51 balls. Shahadat Hossain Dipu also contributed 43 runs. 
 However, Bangladesh will need to improve their ability to take wickets during the middle overs. Hong Kong managed to recover from 52/3 to post 219, highlighting an area where their bowling unit can improve. They will also want their opening batters to provide more substantial contributions after Parvez Hossain Emon fell for just 12 in the previous game.
 Saif Hassan is an important player at the top of the order. He scored an unbeaten 86 against Hong Kong. He accumulated 598 runs in 22 List A appearances. Yasir Ali Chowdhury demonstrated his attacking abilities with an unbeaten 71 off 51 balls in the opening match. He also accumulated 348 runs in 14 List A appearances. 
 Parvez Hossain Emon has scored 108 runs in three ODIs at an average of 36.00. He has 2,874 List-A runs in 80 matches at an average of 38.32. Mohammad Saifuddin picked up 17 wickets in 11 List A appearances during the recent domestic season. Iqbal Hossain Emon was Bangladesh’s leading bowler against Hong Kong, returning figures of 3/33.

 Saif Hassan (C), Shahadat Hossain Dipu, Yasir Ali, Sabbir Rahman, Parvez Hossain Emon, Irfan Sukkur (WK), Mohammad Saifuddin, Samiun Basir Ratul, Rakibul Hasan, Mohammad Rubel and Iqbal Hossain Emon.

 Afghanistan A Preview 
 Afghanistan A suffered a disappointing start to their Rising Stars Asia Cup 2026 campaign, losing their opening fixture against Sri Lanka A by six wickets. Afghanistan struggled to establish themselves and were bowled out for just 139 in 35.3 overs. Darwish Rasooli was the standout performer with an impressive 80 off 89 deliveries, but he received limited support from the other batters. 
 Sri Lanka A chased down the target comfortably, reaching 144/4 in 21.4 overs. Afghanistan will need a much-improved batting performance against Bangladesh A, particularly from their top order. Their batting department includes Ikram Alikhil, Darwish Rasooli, Hassan Eisakhil, Ijaz Ahmad Ahmadzai, Faisal Shinozada and Bahir Shah. 
 Darwish Rasooli is arguably Afghanistan A’s most important batting option. Apart from his 80 off 89 in the opening game, he has an excellent List A record, accumulating 3,029 runs in 73 matches at an average of 54.08. Ikram Alikhil has scored 386 runs in 32 ODIs at an average of 21.44, with a highest score of 86. 
 Allah Mohammad Ghazanfar is one of Afghanistan’s biggest bowling assets. His ability to generate turn and deceive batters makes him particularly dangerous in the middle overs. Bilal Sami is a right-arm fast bowler, who recently featured in Afghanistan’s ODI Tri-Nation Series against Bangladesh and Zimbabwe.

 Weather Conditions
 The weather at Doha on Saturday is likely to be mostly sunny with a high of 31°C and a low of 19°C, along with a 0% chance of rain and north winds at 24 kph. 
 BANA vs AFG-A Pitch Report
 The surface at the West End Park International Cricket Stadium in Doha is expected to offer a balanced contest between bat and ball in the Rising Stars Asia Cup. The venue has hosted limited 50-over cricket, with the average first-innings score in the available ODI records standing at around 238 runs. 
 Batters who settle in and build partnerships could make the most of the conditions, while pacers will look to exploit any early movement with the new ball. Spinners may also come into play during the middle overs as the pitch slows down. A first-innings total of around 240–260 runs could provide a competitive platform in this 50-over contest. 
 Score prediction:  
 If Bangladesh A bat first - 260-270 runs 
 If Afghanistan A bat first - 230-240 runs 
 Toss: To Bowl
 In the last nine ODI matches at the West End Park International Cricket Stadium in Doha, teams batting first have won four times, while chasing sides have secured five victories. The average first-innings score across these matches is around 207 runs, suggesting that the surface could offer a competitive contest between bat and ball. 
 Both teams will need to assess the conditions before making their toss decision. Bowling first could be the preferred option at the toss, although the final decision will depend on the pitch and conditions on match day.
 Toss Prediction: Afghanistan A to win the coin toss. 
 BANA vs AFG-A 
 Winning Prediction 
 Bangladesh A enter this contest as the favourites to win this match. They are a far superior ODI side compared to Afghanistan A. The Tigers have strong white-ball players who have represented Bangladesh in international cricket. Their batting is their main strength which gives them a clear edge. Bangladesh also have a quality bowling attack. This is also a big match for both teams as both teams would eye a winning momentum in the competition. 
 Bangladesh A to win.
